fixes.explanation: Perez and Zerah are sons of Judah (Genesis 46:12), and Judah's blessing is back in verse 7. Joseph's blessing closes with "Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh." (Deuteronomy 33:17). Those are Joseph's two sons (Genesis 41:51-52). Good names, friend, they just belong to a different tribe's story.

Gershon and Kohath are sons of Levi (Genesis 46:11), so they belong back with Levi's blessing in verses 8 to 11. Joseph's blessing closes with "Such are the myriads of Ephraim, and such are the thousands of Manasseh." (Deuteronomy 33:17). Those are Joseph's two sons (Genesis 41:51-52). Good names, friend, they just live in a different part of the passage.
